answer: Each identity must hold a certified doula registration, earned with supervised attended births and a certification exam costing about $180 per candidate. A farm needs a distinct registered doula per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $180,000 plus months of supervised births each. The ripple of cheap aliases fades: every fake adds another exam, the cipher of the birth register exposes shared names, and the mirror of the certification board reflects duplicates.
